KAZAR PROJECT DIAGNOSTIC

KAZAR Project Diagnostic

Understand the project before committing to the next step.

See what the Diagnostic covers
01 / KAZAR PROJECT DIAGNOSTIC

What it is

A scoped professional review of the current project position and construction questions.

02 / KAZAR PROJECT DIAGNOSTIC

Who it is for

Clients with an incomplete brief, design-stage interfaces, a project at transition, or a private office seeking a clearer construction position.

03 / KAZAR PROJECT DIAGNOSTIC

What KAZAR reviews

Current status; key risks; technical observations; programme; procurement; cost position; missing information. Only information and access agreed for the assessment are reviewed.

04 / KAZAR PROJECT DIAGNOSTIC

What the client receives

A structured assessment of the current position, priority questions, dependencies and recommended next step. Recommendations identify their source and limits.

05 / KAZAR PROJECT DIAGNOSTIC

What is not included

Not a free quotation, detailed BOQ, full design package or exhaustive survey. Specialist investigations and additional access require a separately agreed scope.

06 / KAZAR PROJECT DIAGNOSTIC

How it starts

1. Send a short project enquiry.
2. Discuss the question, stage and available information.
3. Agree assessment scope, outputs, timing and commercial basis.
4. Complete the Diagnostic intake after that discussion.

07 / KAZAR PROJECT DIAGNOSTIC

Discuss a Project Diagnostic.

Start with the project question. The enquiry does not commission the assessment.
